title: Open Food Log v0: food
description: One food: what it is, what 100 g (or 100 ml, or a serving) of it holds, and the portions people measure it in. v0.1; may change until v1.

id.description: namespace:slug. ofc: is the Open Food Catalogue; gtin: is a packaged product by its GTIN as 14 digits; usr: is one person's own food and recipe: one person's recipe, each meaningful only where it was made.

name.description: The canonical name, in English for the catalogue.

kind.description: generic: a food as such (a raw egg). branded: a packaged product. restaurant: a dish as one restaurant serves it. custom: a person's own food. supplement: a dietary supplement, dosed per serving (label.nutrients_per_serving) rather than weighed.

gtin.description: Barcodes the product is sold under, as 14 digits (shorter codes zero-padded on the left).

kind.description: How far a matcher may trust it: legacy names only suggest.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag, for a regional name.

nutrients_basis.description: Which set of values the source declared: per 100 g (nutrients_per_100g), per 100 ml (nutrients_per_100ml, as drinks' labels give them) or per serving (label.nutrients_per_serving, as supplements' labels give them). The other sets, where present, were worked out from it.

nutrients_per_100g.description: What 100 g of the food holds, as eaten in the state the name says (raw, cooked, dry). A nutrient left out is unknown, never zero. Empty ({}) when the food's values are known only per 100 ml or per serving and it can't be weighed.

nutrients_per_100ml.description: What 100 ml of the food holds, for a drink labelled that way. With density_g_per_ml, nutrients_per_100g should be given too (these divided by the density).

density_g_per_ml.description: Grams per millilitre, so an amount in ml or fl oz can be weighed. Leave it out when it isn't known.

portions.description: Named measures with their weight: '1 large' egg is 50 g, '1 cup' of oats 81 g. Cups and spoons are portions, because what they weigh depends on the food.

category.description: What kind of food it is, in a named scheme.

code.description: The category's code in the scheme, where it has one.

scheme.description: Whose categories: fdc (FoodData Central food categories), gpc (GS1 Global Product Classification), off (Open Food Facts), or a producer's own x-<vendor>.

allergens.description: Allergens the food contains or may contain. An allergen not listed is unknown, never absent: OFL has no way to say a food is free of one.

presence.description: may_contain is a precautionary statement ('may contain traces of').

diet_flags.description: Diets the food suits. A flag not listed is unknown, never a no.

certified_by.description: The body that certified it, for a certified claim.

ingredients_text.description: The ingredients list as the label prints it.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the text's language.

glycemic_index.description: The food's glycemic index, against glucose = 100 unless reference says otherwise.

source.description: Where the value comes from, e.g. the International Tables of Glycemic Index (2021).

glycemic_load.description: The glycemic load of a stated weight of the food: GI × available carbohydrate in that weight / 100.

grams.description: The weight the load is for, usually a serving.

identifiers.description: The food's IDs in other databases.

dsld_id.description: NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database label ID, for a supplement.

ofl_version.description: The Open Food Log version the document was written to, as MAJOR.MINOR ("0.1"). A document without one is 0.0, the first draft.

basis.description: declared: stated by the label, the maker or a database that measured it. inferred: worked out or guessed (from the name, the ingredients, a photo or a model).

allergen.description: The EU's 14 (Regulation 1169/2011, Annex II) and the US's 9 (FALCPA and the FASTER Act). The US's crustacean shellfish is crustaceans; wheat is listed apart from gluten because the US names it alone.

nutrients.description: Amounts keyed by nutrient, each in the unit its key names (nutrients.json). A key left out is unknown, never zero. x- keys are a producer's own (x-<vendor>-<name>_<unit>).

id.description: Unique within the food; a meal item names it.

label.description: What one of it is called: '1 large', '1 cup, sliced'.

is_default.description: The portion to assume when a person names the food without a size. At most one per food.

label.description: What the package's nutrition label declares, kept as printed. Its numbers are declared; nutrients_per_100g may be worked out from them.

region.description: Whose labelling rules the label follows, which decides what carbohydrate means (us, ca: total, fibre included; eu, uk, au: available, fibre excluded) and which daily values the percentages are of.

serving.description: The declared serving: its text as printed and, where the label gives one, its weight or volume.

nutrients_per_serving.description: What one declared serving holds. For a supplement, the dose.

percent_daily_values.description: The label's %DV (or %RI) per serving, keyed by nutrient key, as printed. Percentages of the region's reference values, not amounts.

license.description: SPDX identifier where there is one.
The record's own licence, as an SPDX identifier.

generated.description: JSON pointers to values a model produced rather than a source or a person.
